canonical_project: Amazon hyperscale data centre campus at Bharat Future City / Chandanvelly
notes: Telangana CM Revanth Reddy performed the symbolic groundbreaking (Mar 2025) for Amazon's hyperscale data centre at Bharat Future City near Hyderabad, where AWS has been allotted 98 acres at Chandanvelly (Ranga Reddy district). Supports AWS cloud/AI growth; MW capacity not disclosed.
